ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between high-intensity white/light-grey pixels (central lobes) and low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels (perimeter and markings) in an approximate 70:30 distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity region covering central and distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity mapping along the entire trailing edge and median notch. A significant dark contiguous patch is located on the proximal inner quadrant of the left lobe near the fluke insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude variations. Extensive jagged peaks and valleys extracted along the continuous linear boundary, particularly extreme serrations on the distal half of the left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave curve transitioning from the notch, becoming convex at the distal extremities of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles) on the distal-most edge of the left lobe and on the dorsal peduncle region near the fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white ventral surface across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged tissue irregularities on the left lobe trailing edge; extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the fluke surface; presence of sessile barnacle colonies on the fluke and peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark, roughly circular pigmentation cluster on the inner-proximal region of the left lobe near the median notch.
